## 1. My answer

I'd open a trading account at **Pesagot** (פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ) and put money every month into **Yelin Lapidot's S&P 500 fund** (ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), number 5139282). I'd use the page's example amounts, 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month. Over 10 years that's 70,000 ₪ of my own money, and the page says I'd end up with about **86,492 ₪**.

How sure I am:
- **Fairly sure (about 70%) about the account.** The page put Pesagot at #1 with a star and "הזול" (the cheapest). My own bank, Hapoalim, is #6 at 81,471 ₪, about 5,000 ₪ less. That gap made me want to switch.
- **Less sure about the fund.** The "next pair" was only 43 ₪ behind (‎"‎-43 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם"). So I think picking a fund barely matters, as long as I avoid the expensive ones.
- **Not sure what 86,492 really means.** It says "בערכים ריאליים" and "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל". Making only about 16,000 ₪ on 70,000 over ten years felt low. I couldn't tell if that's bad or just "in today's money."

## 2. Parts I actually used

- The top: the title "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד", the index buttons (S&P 500 was already picked), and the amount boxes "סכום היום", "הפקדה חודשית" and "תשואה בשנה".
- The big result box: "הפקדתם 70,000 ₪", "הבחירה שלכם · הזול 86,492 ₪" and the "הזוג הבא בתור" card next to it.
- The account list "כל החשבונות", but only the names and the big numbers on the left.
- The fund card "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", to get its name and number.
- The sentence at the end of the step chart: "הכי הרבה בכל המחירונים: 86,492 ₪, ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), פסגות". This confirmed my answer.

## 3. Block by block

1. **Title and index buttons (screen 1): used.** S&P 500 was already selected, so I didn't touch anything. I skipped MSCI, ת"א-125 and the others. I also ignored "אפשר להחזיק אותו גם דרך קרן חוץ" because I didn't know what it meant.
2. **Sliders (screens 1–2): used.** I kept 10,000, 500 and 7%. I didn't press "אינפלציה" because I wasn't sure what it would change. I skipped the dollar-rate line ("שער הדולר 3.17 ₪ · מחושב משערי הייחוס של הבנק המרכזי האירופי").
3. **Result box (screen 2): used, the most important part.** "הזוג הבא בתור" confused me at first. "Pair" of what? Later I understood it means account plus fund.
4. **"כמה זה עולה לכם ב־10 שנים" with the coloured bar (screens 2–3): skimmed.** The pink part (5,689) was the biggest. From the legend, pink seems to be "מס" (tax). The other colours I didn't follow. Under it, "החשבון 1 ₪ יותר / הקרן 58 ₪ פחות / המס 14 ₪ יותר" were such tiny numbers that I stopped reading.
5. **Pesagot card (screen 3): used.** "מה החשבון גובה ב־10 שנים: 1,057 ₪" was clear and nice to see.
6. **Account list (screens 4–7): used the top, skimmed the rest.** I read the grey intro text about "3 מתוך 15" quickly and didn't really get it. I did notice the "לא בחישוב / מחיר אחר לצעירים, לחיילים משוחררים, לסטודנטים" tags. I'm young, so maybe my bank is cheaper for me than shown? That made me unsure. I skipped "אינטראקטיב ישראל" and "Interactive Brokers" with "אין נתון".
7. **Fund card and "כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500" list (screens 7–9): skimmed.** I used Yelin at the top. The "-43 ₪ / -213 ₪ / -447 ₪" numbers I understood as "less than my choice." I didn't understand the "+0.37% בשנה · שנה אחת" lines.
8. **"למה חלק מהקרנות בלי מחיר בפסגות" and the "מול המדד" explanation (screen 9): skipped.** It was too technical.
9. **"מה הכי משנה את מה שיישאר לכם" chart (screen 10): skimmed, and it was interesting.** The table showed that 12 years instead of 10 adds 19,116 ₪, and 600 instead of 500 a month adds 14,474 ₪. So the time I stay in and how much I put in matter much more than which bank I use. That surprised me, but it didn't change my choice.
10. **"עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" plus the dollar chart, the fund chart and the table (screens 11–14): mostly skipped, and it confused me.** I got the bottom line: "הנטרול לא מגן מירידה של השוק", and the fund without it would leave "9,460 ₪ יותר". So I'd pick the one without "נטרול". The table on screen 13 had numbers printed on top of each other ("‎-21.8%‎" mixed with "‎-18.2%‎"), so I couldn't read it.
11. **Step chart "מנקודת ההתחלה ועד הכי הרבה" (screens 15–16): skimmed.** It starts from "MTF סל S&P 500 (4D), ירושלים", but I never chose that, so why start there? The final sentence was useful.
12. **"עכשיו: ... ירושלים" lists (screens 16–19): skipped.** They repeat the earlier lists with different numbers (Pesagot 84,148 here vs 86,492 earlier), which confused me. I noticed one thing: "קרן שנקנית בחו"ל" was 20,100 ₪ worse, so don't do that.
13. **Footer notes (screen 19): skimmed.** I read "תשואה לדוגמה, לא תחזית" and "האתר לא ממליץ על מדד".

## 4. Lists, tables and charts

- **Account list:** I looked at the rank number, the bank name, the big amount (86,492, 83,396…), and sometimes the small number under it (1,057, 4,541), which I guessed is the account's cost. I ignored the round select buttons, the small coloured bars (too small to read colours) and the ⌄ arrows.
- **Coloured cost bar (screen 3):** I only noticed the big pink chunk and the yellow 698 (I guess "דמי משמרת"). I didn't try to match green, orange, red or grey.
- **Fund list:** I looked at the names and the minus numbers on the left. I ignored the pills ("קרן מחקה", "כמה דרכים יחד", "קרן סל"), the 7-digit numbers, and the "+0.37%" lines.
- **"What changes the most" chart:** I mostly ignored the lines (yellow שנים, orange הפקדה חודשית, pink תשואה בשנה, turquoise סכום היום). The table below with "ההפרש" was what I read.
- **Dollar bar chart and teal/yellow fund chart:** I looked at the labels "+13.4" and "‎-12.5‎", and at the yellow ‎-21.8‎ in 2022. I didn't really understand what the grey vs. white bars mean.
- **Step chart:** I looked at the three amounts (79,176 / +4,972 / +2,344) and the turquoise and pink legend. I ignored the "🔒 נשען על כלל מס פתוח" lock.
- **"יותר / פחות" lists:** I only noticed green = better and red = worse.

## 5. What I didn't understand

- "קרן מחקה", "קרן סל", "קרן חוץ", "4D" vs "4A", "MTF", "UCITS ETF USD (Accumulating)", "נאמן", "דמי ניהול קבועים / משתנים", "נטרול מט"ח", "דמי משמרת", "העמלות זו על זו".
- "בערכים ריאליים" / "בכסף של היום": is 86,492 after inflation already? Then what does the "אינפלציה" button do?
- Why the same Pesagot number is 86,492 at the top but 84,148 in the bottom list.
- "זוג" (pair), until I worked it out.
- What "לא בחישוב" means for me. Would my bank actually be cheaper because I'm young?

## 6. What I wanted and couldn't find

- **How to actually do it:** how to open a Pesagot account, whether I can set up an automatic 500 ₪ every month, and how I type the fund number in.
- **Is Pesagot safe?** It's not a bank. What happens to my money if they close?
- **Taking money out early:** can I if I need it, and does it cost anything?
- **Whether 7% is realistic** for the S&P 500, and whether that's before or after inflation.
- **The young-people price:** if Hapoalim or Leumi give "מחיר אחר לצעירים", how much would that change the ranking?
- **Other options:** is this better than other things people mention, like a קופת גמל להשקעה? The page doesn't say.

## 7. If half the page had to go

First I'd cut the whole currency-hedging section ("עם נטרול מט"ח או בלי" with its two charts and the broken table). After that, the second set of lists that start from "ירושלים" (screens 16–19), then the "קרן מחקה / קרן סל" pills and the "+0.37% בשנה" lines in the fund list. I'd keep the sliders, the result box with the top account and fund, the top of the account list, and the "what changes the most" table.
